#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

struct Task {
    long long pow[16];

    int solve(long long n) {
        pow[0] = 1LL;
        for (int i = 1; i < 16; ++i) pow[i] = 10LL * pow[i - 1] + 1LL;
        return f(n);
    }

    int f(long long n) {
        if (n <= 1LL) return (int)n;
        int pos = 15;
        for (; pow[pos] >= n; --pos);
        ++pos;
        long long m1 = 0LL, m2 = pow[pos];
        int x1 = 0, x2 = pos + 1;
        while (m1 + pow[pos - 1] <= n) {
            m1 += pow[pos - 1];
            x1 += pos;
        }
        while (m2 - pow[pos - 1] >= n) {
            m2 -= pow[pos - 1];
            x2 += pos;
        }
        x1 += f(n - m1);
        x2 += f(m2 - n);
        return min(x1, x2);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    Task task;
    int result = task.solve(n);
    cout << result << endl;
    return 0;
}
